title: Natural native total tensor models and signed symmetry without Hom
statement: Let l be prime and Y any scheme. In the native module category A of [def-sf-native-weil-closed-models], use the canonical derived monoidal structure on D(A). There exist a symmetric structure beta, isomorphisms model(P,Q): Q(Q) tensor Q(P) ≅ Q(ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q)) whenever P is NativeOrdinaryKFlat, and complex isomorphisms swap(P,Q): ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q) ≅ ordinaryTensorTotal(Q,P) for all P,Q. The model is natural on complex maps f:P→P' and g:Q→Q' whenever P and P' are K-flat. The swap satisfies NativeOrdinarySignedSwap, and for K-flat P,Q, beta(Q(Q),Q(P)) followed by model(Q,P) equals model(P,Q) followed by Q(swap(P,Q)). This statement mentions no internal Hom or adjunction.

source.place: Tags 06YS and 06YT, K-flat representatives and tensor preservation; Tag 0FPT, derived tensor and symmetry; native tensor transport step 1. Labels lemma-K-flat-resolution, lemma-derived-tor-quasi-isomorphism-other-side, lemma-symmetric-monoidal-derived.

proof.text: Use the balanced tensor comparison NativeAux.tensorComponent and its two naturality equations, including OrdinaryModuleHom.tensorRightIso_naturality, to identify the ordinary tensor bicomplex with the flipped canonical tensor bicomplex. Totalize and compose with mapBifunctorFlipIso to construct kappa(P,Q): ordinaryTensorTotal(P,Q) ≅ Q tensor P. On the (p,q) summand kappa is (-1)^(pq) times the underived comparison. Testing on summands proves naturality.

Transport the acyclic-test K-flat hypothesis across kappa and apply RingedDerivedNative.kFlat_of_acyclic. Its localization_isIso_mu makes the canonical tensorator invertible when P is K-flat. Compose that isomorphism with Q(kappa inverse) to obtain model; tensorator naturality and kappa naturality prove its naturality square.

Set swap=kappa(P,Q) followed by the standard complex braiding followed by kappa(Q,P) inverse. The three bidegree signs multiply to (-1)^(pq); the balanced tensor quotient equation identifies the underlying map with the ambient signed swap. Take RingedDerivedNative.derivedSymmetric on the canonical derived monoidal structure. The localizationLaxBraided equation, after cancelling kappa inverse followed by kappa, is precisely the desired braiding square.

lean.statement:
theorem native_ordinary_tensor_representatives (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u}) :
    ∃ β : SymmetricCategory (DerivedCategory (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y)),
    ∃ model : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ,
      NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P →
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj P ≅
          DerivedCategory.Q.obj (ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q)),
    ∃ swap : ∀ P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ,
      ordinaryTensorTotal l Y P Q ≅ ordinaryTensorTotal l Y Q P,
      (∀ (P Q P' Q' : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hP' : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P')
        (f : P ⟶ P') (g : Q ⟶ Q'),
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map g ⊗ₘ DerivedCategory.Q.map f) ≫ (model P' Q' hP').hom =
          (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctorMap f g (ordinaryTensorBifunctor l Y) (.up ℤ))) ∧
      NativeOrdinarySignedSwap l Y swap ∧
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex (ProEtale.AdicSheaf l Y) ℤ)
        (hP : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y P) (hQ : NativeOrdinaryKFlat l Y Q),
        (β.toBraidedCategory.braiding (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q)
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).hom ≫ (model Q P hQ).hom =
          (model P Q hP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (swap P Q).hom)
